caps.name: Plan
caps.line: Decide what is worth building next, from evidence, and write it down so an agent can run with it.
caps.agents: Read the code and the telemetry first, then break the brief into pieces small enough to ship.
caps.me: I choose what goes round the loop, and write the brief: the outcome, the limits, and how we will know it worked.
evidence: Ran cross-team projects at Cybrary, often as the technical project manager.
Led engineering strategy and the team at Stove & Grill Parts as revenue grew from $1M to $10M.
Wrote the migration plan and the test plan for moving checkout from Chargebee to Paddle.

caps.name: Build
caps.line: Test-driven. The failing test is written before the code, so every change arrives with its own proof.
caps.agents: Write the failing test, then the code that passes it, then tidy. One piece of work, one branch.
caps.me: Hands off. The rules they build by are written down before they start, and I answer only what they cannot decide.
evidence: A form system that ships with 65 tests and 100% coverage.
API clients generated from OpenAPI specs, so a backend change reaches the front-end types on its own.
The app runs in the browser against deterministic mocked APIs, with no backend.

caps.name: Assure
caps.line: Prove it does the thing it is supposed to do, end to end, in a safe copy of production before it goes near the real one.
caps.agents: Run the end-to-end tests against staging, and fix what fails before anyone else sees it.
caps.me: I own the standard: what has to be true before anything ships.
evidence: Took an e-commerce platform to WCAG 2.2 AA: a full audit, the fixes, and a plan to stay compliant.
Configurable role-based access across multi-tenant teams.
A marketing site that holds 90+ Lighthouse scores.

caps.name: Release
caps.line: Make shipping boring: green checks merge it, and a merge deploys it.
caps.agents: Nobody presses a button. The pipeline does it, the same way every time.
caps.me: Hands off. What counts as green was decided long before.
evidence: Built CI/CD pipelines that deploy every service and site at Stove & Grill Parts.
Scripts that keep code and CMS in step, cutting 95% of manual Contentful setup.
This page deploys on every merge, in about two minutes.

caps.name: Run
caps.line: Watch it in production. What the telemetry says becomes the next plan, and the loop closes.
caps.agents: Turn telemetry and alerts from production into new work, already sorted.
caps.me: I read what production says, and choose what goes round next.
evidence: A monitoring server that watches prices, stock and order status, and says what to fix.
Sync services moving catalog, stock and sales between six sales channels.
Reports delivered as CSV, PDF, email and Google Sheets.
